comment: Every app here is installed on the development machine. group = the charter coverage group, toolkit = what the binary links. mode: wayland hides nothing (X11 apps fall back to Xwayland), x11 forces X11. registrar: a com.canonical.AppMenu.Registrar stub runs before the app unless a row says false, as the daemon own registrar does in use.

apps.name: qBittorrent
launch: D="$HOME/.var/app/org.qbittorrent.qBittorrent/config/qBittorrent"; mkdir -p "$D" && printf '[LegalNotice]\nAccepted=true\n' > "$D/qBittorrent.conf" && exec flatpak run --nosocket=wayland --socket=x11 --talk-name=com.canonical.AppMenu.Registrar --env=QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb org.qbittorrent.qBittorrent

export_hint.note: A flatpak sets its own QT_QPA_PLATFORM, so the env var has to be passed with --env.

apps.name: Visual Studio Code (native title bar)
launch: D="$HOME/.var/app/com.visualstudio.code/config/Code/User"; mkdir -p "$D" && echo '{"window.titleBarStyle": "native"}' > "$D/settings.json" && exec flatpak run --nosocket=wayland --socket=x11 --talk-name=com.canonical.AppMenu.Registrar com.visualstudio.code --ozone-platform=x11 --password-store=basic --disable-gpu --new-window

export_hint.note: VS Code draws its own menu with the default custom title bar and sets no Electron menu; the native title bar setting makes it build one.

apps.name: Firefox (global menu pref)
launch: mkdir -p "$HOME/ffp" && echo 'user_pref("widget.gtk.global-menu.enabled", true);' > "$HOME/ffp/user.js" && exec firefox --no-remote --profile "$HOME/ffp" about:blank

export_hint.note: Firefox exports the menubar over com.canonical.dbusmenu through libdbusmenu on X11 only, with the pref on.

apps.name: Firefox (global menu pref)
launch: P="$HOME/.var/app/org.mozilla.firefox/ffp"; mkdir -p "$P" && echo 'user_pref("widget.gtk.global-menu.enabled", true);' > "$P/user.js" && exec flatpak run --nosocket=wayland --socket=x11 --talk-name=com.canonical.AppMenu.Registrar org.mozilla.firefox --no-remote --profile "$P" about:blank

export_hint.note: The Firefox flatpak runtime has no libdbusmenu-glib, so the pref has nothing to load.
